title: UserRestrictedPinResetPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'user.restricted-pin-reset' (H2). Emitted when the server-local `loombre admin reset-pin <username>` CLI command clears a user's restricted-content opt-in, PIN hash, and live unlock state (packages/db/src/query/identity.js's resetRestrictedPinAndEmit). There is no HTTP path to this event — filesystem access to the running server is the privilege boundary. ADMIN_ONLY delivery (apps/server/src/plugins/event-taxonomy.ts): this is instance-administration/recovery activity, not catalog data, and is never granted to a plugin subscriber. Never carries secrets — no PIN or hash material, ever.

actor.description: How the reset was performed. A closed enum of one today (deliberate — future-proofs the shape without inventing a surface that doesn't exist yet); the envelope's own actorUserId is null for this type since the CLI runs outside any authenticated user session.
